images.title: Chief Justice John Marshall, engraving by Asher B. Durand after Henry Inman, 1833
images.note: Marshall the man (chief justice 1801-1835); near-contemporary engraving (1833), CC0. Verified 2678x3772, 2.6MB. Alt gap: NGA holds the contemporary 1808 Saint-Memin portrait and the Senate holds an 1845 Kellogg lithograph, but neither exposes a bot-accessible high-res image URL.

images.title: James Madison, fourth President of the United States; lithograph by N. E. Maurin after Gilbert Stuart, 1828
images.note: Marbury beat: Madison as Secretary of State, the defendant who withheld the undelivered commissions. Later lithograph (1828) after Stuart, not from the 1801-03 period. LOC LC-DIG-ppmsca-19166, no known restrictions. Verified 1500x1897, 815KB via IIIF. Alt gap: no second bot-accessible institution found.

images.title: Georgia, from the latest Authorities (Mathew Carey), 1795
images.source: David Rumsey Map Collection via Internet Archive
images.note: Fletcher v. Peck beat: shows Georgia with its vast pre-1802 western land claims (the Yazoo lands, now AL/MS) sold in the corrupt 1795 deal. Contemporary to the fraud. Verified 1536x1305, 619KB. Alt gap: a second 1796 Tanner Georgia map exists on the same host; LOC/DLG/Yale copies are bot-blocked.
